name: Piano no Mori no Mankai no Shita
original_name: ピアノの森の満開の下
source:
Ryutaro cares about his younger sister Sakuno more than anything else in the world. But, she has an incurable sickness eating away at her. When the doctor announces that she only has a week left to live, he takes her to a sanitarium with some mysterious tickets, seeing it as her last hope. Upon arriving at the secluded building, tucked away in the mountains, they are greeted up by Konohana, the nurse in charge and the only human nearby. With only seven days left, just what can happen? Just what can be done?

[From a [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/11/16/piano-no-mori-no-mankai-no-shita-review/]review[/url] by Choux]
translation:
龙太郎最珍视的人，是妹妹樱乃。然而，一种无法治愈的疾病正在侵蚀她的身体。医生宣告樱乃只剩一周生命后，龙太郎带着几张神秘的票，将她送往一所疗养院，把那里视为最后的希望。两人抵达藏在深山中的僻静建筑，迎接他们的是负责照护的护士木花，也是附近唯一的人类。仅剩的七天里，究竟会发生什么？他们又能做些什么？

[摘自Choux的[url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2009/11/16/piano-no-mori-no-mankai-no-shita-review/]评测[/url]]
